title: Discovery mismatch for hlbat209
input:
Discovery mismatch for hlbat209
Received 2026-09-13T05:50:00Z from Tessa Bellamy <tessa.bellamy@harbourline.example>

FYI - pllease see below.

Inventory reconciliation threw up an oddity - see the fields below.

Hostname: hlbat209
IP address: 10.86.149.22
Discovery source: network scan

Thanks,
Tessa Bellamy
Head of Function, Information Security
Haarbourline Mutual Finance Ltd

classification.rationale: [CLI classifier (agy/gemini-3.8-flash-low) — not JEV; default threshold 0.35 is uncalibrated] The email describes an inventory reconciliation mismatch for hostname hlbat209 discovered via network scan, clearly mapping to IT asset and CMDB/inventory management.

outcome.conclusion: The host hlbat209 at IP 10.86.149.22 was detected responding with an unrecognised MAC address (E6:1E:8E:92:8A:4C) differing from the registered CMDB record (20:95:44:85:4A:9A). A security alert ALT-3733ABEF confirms this hardware mismatch, indicating potential ARP spoofing or a rogue device. A security incident ticket has been opened and approval for network isolation has been requested.

evidence.note: CMDB item for hlbat209 indicating registered MAC 20:95:44:85:4A:9A and owner Nia Ashworth
High severity network monitoring alert for hardware address mismatch on hlbat209 showing MAC E6:1E:8E:92:8A:4C
Simulated security incident ticket opened for investigation of rogue host / ARP mismatch
Pending approval request submitted to authorise network isolation of CI-B33F4001

recommendations: Authorise pending approval APR-6F8C269AA0 to isolate the asset on the network.
Investigate physical switch port at Office-Eastbridge corresponding to IP 10.86.149.22.
Verify with manager Leila Radcliffe whether any hardware swap took place while Nia Ashworth is on leave.
outcome.summary: Investigation into hlbat209 revealed a high-severity MAC address discrepancy indicative of a rogue device or ARP mismatch. Incident ticket SIM-TKT-001 opened and isolation approval requested under APR-6F8C269AA0.
unresolved: Identity and physical origin of device presenting MAC E6:1E:8E:92:8A:4C.
Whether this is an unrecorded hardware replacement or an unauthorised device on the corporate network.
